findings.summary: The Fish completion script breaks because format_completion now emits three newline-separated lines per item, but Fish splits command substitution on newlines and iterates single lines, so metadata parsing fails and completion is broken for every command.

Escaping newlines as a literal \n is lossy (indistinguishable from a literal backslash-n) and Fish does not unescape it, so users see a literal \n in descriptions; replacing newlines with a space would be better.
The Fish script compares against "_" as the no-help sentinel, so a real help string that is exactly "_" is indistinguishable from no help.
